import unittest
from atlas.service import DocumentService


class SmokeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_document_lifecycle(self):
        service = DocumentService()
        document = service.repository.create("a", {"title": "Welcome"})
        self.assertEqual(document["revision"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(service.list_documents()["items"], [document])
        service.cache.put("a", document, now=0, ttl=10)
        self.assertEqual(service.cached_document("a", now=1), document)

    def test_service_helpers(self):
        service = DocumentService()
        self.assertTrue(service.authorized(["docs:read"], "docs", "read"))
        self.assertEqual(service.storage_key("/srv/data", "docs/a"), "/srv/data/docs/a")
        self.assertEqual(service.dependencies_for({"a": ["b"]}, "a"), ["b"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest

from atlas.repository import Repository


class EventRepositoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_first_event_wins_and_only_new_keys_receive_sequences(self):
        repository = Repository()
        first = repository.put_event("a", {"value": "original"})
        second = repository.put_event("b", {"value": "second"})

        for payload in ({"value": "replacement"}, None, {}):
            self.assertEqual(repository.put_event("a", payload), first)
        self.assertEqual(repository.put_event("b", {}), second)
        third = repository.put_event("c", {})

        self.assertEqual([first["sequence"], second["sequence"],
                          third["sequence"]], [1, 2, 3])
        self.assertEqual(repository.events, {"a": first, "b": second, "c": third})

    def test_nested_payload_and_returned_events_are_isolated(self):
        repository = Repository()
        payload = {"items": [{"value": "original"}]}
        expected = {"key": "a", "payload": {"items": [{"value": "original"}]},
                    "sequence": 1}
        first = repository.put_event("a", payload)
        payload["items"][0]["value"] = "input mutation"
        first["payload"]["items"].append({"value": "return mutation"})
        first["sequence"] = 99
        first["key"] = "changed"

        duplicate = repository.put_event("a", {"items": []})
        self.assertEqual(duplicate, expected)
        duplicate["payload"]["items"][0]["value"] = "duplicate mutation"
        duplicate["sequence"] = 100

        self.assertEqual(repository.events["a"], expected)
        self.assertEqual(repository.put_event("a", None), expected)
